choices.why: At 198 cm, this rectangular table in warm dark wood seats six to eight comfortably and matches the brown tones of the floor and the kitchen cabinets.
The high-back chairs in dark gray fabric with espresso legs are classic and elegant, and three sets of two make the six chairs requested.
The 51 cm white fabric drum shade is large, softens the light and gives a classic but current touch above the table without competing with the kitchen pendants.
This walnut-tone sideboard with cane doors adds warmth and texture, its 173 cm length fits the tall stretch of the stair wall, and its color goes with the table and the railing.

answer.why: The warm dark woods of the table and sideboard pick up the tones of the floor, the cabinets and the railing, while the gray upholstery and the white drum shade bring a soft, current contrast against the cream walls, for a classic, warm look.
